items.text: Let it be — Gavin's line was a musing to the air, not a prayer, and I'd already told him nine minutes ago exactly how thin things are; a second voice confirming "no, no merchant" would only be the sky nagging a man who's chosen to sit and wait. (Noted for the next working turn: the Cave Mouth still shows no memorial line — Chris died before that shipped, so it remains untested.)
